newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia NIKoil buys into StPetersburg phone network.
newsitem.headline: Russia NIKoil buys into StPetersburg phone network.

text.p: Russia's NIKoil investment group bought a 1.2-percent stake in the Peterburgskaya Telefonnaya Syet (St Petersburg Telephone Network) at a December 11 auction, NIKoil's press service said on Monday.
"We bought all 12 lots put up for auction," a spokesman told Reuters.

A total of 5.6 million shares were sold for 31.5 billion roubles. The starting price for shares with a face value of 1,000 roubles was 5,000 roubles. The average price of sold shares reached 5,628 roubles.
NIKoil, which acts as advisers to and is a shareholder of Russia's biggest oil group, NK LUKoil, invests mainly in the oil industry.
But the spokesman said the St Petersburg telecom deal was not the first time NIKoil had invested in companies dealing in other spheres.
Russia's Svyazinvest telecom holding company is a major shareholder in St Petersburg Telephone, with a 41.8-percent stake.
Shares in the St Petersburg telecom closed at $1.20 on Monday on the Russian Trading System.
